name: aphrody-web
description: Single configuration contract of the Aphrody web layer: engine binary and listener, fetch/crawl defaults, allowed hosts, robots policy, storage paths and Tauri debug bridge. Consumers read it through @aphrody/agent-browser/config; environment variables listed under env override the file, command-line flags override both. Secrets, cookies and browser profiles never live here.

crawl.allowedHostsPolicy: An empty list means the seed hosts only; subdomains of a listed host are included.
crawl.robotsNote: robots.txt Disallow and Crawl-delay are honoured when obeyRobots is true; set it to false only for first-party hosts you own.

network.privateNetworkNote: Loopback, RFC1918 and link-local targets are rejected by the SSRF guard. Local fixtures opt in per process with --allow-private-network (crawl) or OBSCURA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=1 (CDP server).

storage.secretsPolicy: Cookies, tokens and Chromium profiles stay in their protected stores (tools/config/secrets-contract.json). Nothing in this layer prints or logs cookie values.

tauriDebug.tokenPolicy: A random per-process token is written to the discovery file; clients present it as ?token=. The file is mode 0600.
tauriDebug.releaseBuilds: The plugin is compiled only with the debug-bridge feature and only registered under cfg(debug_assertions).

env.APHRODY_WEB_BIN: Absolute path of the aphrody-web binary (overrides binaryCandidates).
env.APHRODY_BROWSER_CDP_URL: ws:// endpoint of a running engine; clients attach instead of spawning.
env.APHRODY_WEB_TEST_CDP_URL: Endpoint used by the test harness instead of spawning an engine.
env.OBSCURA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK: 1 lets the CDP server and fetch reach loopback/private addresses (tests, fixtures).
env.OBSCURA_PROXY: HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy for fetch, scrape and the CDP server.
env.OBSCURA_FETCH_MAX_BODY_BYTES: Cap on a fetched response body.
env.OBSCURA_NAV_TIMEOUT_MS: Navigation timeout of the CDP server.
env.OBSCURA_CDP_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS: Per-command timeout of the CDP server.
env.OBSCURA_CDP_TOKEN: Bearer token required by the CDP server when set.
env.OBSCURA_MCP_TOKEN: Bearer token required by the Obscura MCP HTTP transport when set.
env.APHRODY_TAURI_DEBUG: 1 enables the Tauri debug bridge in debug builds.
env.APHRODY_TAURI_DEBUG_PORT: Fixed port for the Tauri debug bridge (default: ephemeral).
